title: Tortle Combat (miniquest)
start: Talk to Postie Pete-za by the entrance to the Varrock Sewers.

items.t: 16 planks (other types of planks will not work; can be inside a plank box)
60 iron nails (higher level nails will not work)
Adult or elder common brown rabbit

recommended.t: Some means of Varrock teleport, preferably one of the two below
Master constructor's outfit, Varrock estate agent teleport is the closest to the Varrock sewer
Dave's spellbook, teleport to Varrock Museum is as good as the outfit
Teleport to get to the Grand Exchange, such as Luck of the Dwarves

rewards.t: Tortle lamp of construction, which gives 10000 Construction XP
Tortle lamp of farming, which gives 1000 Farming XP
Tortle lamp of magic, which gives 1000 Magic XP

steps.t: Talk to Postie Pete-za by the entrance to Varrock Sewers with at least 1 free inventory space. [Chat: Accept]
Open the manhole and enter the Varrock Sewers.
Go east and squeeze through the pipe.
Talk to Wolfgang on the bridge. [Chat: 4 What will you do now? › 1 Yes]
Talk to the Varrock estate agent. He is located in a building just north of the sewer entrance. [Chat: 1 Tortle Combat.]
Return to Wolfgang. [Chat: 1 You should probably stop sending rats to the estate agent.]
Build the equipment around the area with the 16 planks, 2 buckets of sand, 1 empty sack, 3 ropes, and 60 iron nails.
Talk to Wolfgang. [Chat: 1 I have constructed all your equipment!]
Talk to Gustav to the north of Wolfgang.
Talk to Granny Potterington at Manor Farm with a kebab and Dense honeycomb in your inventory. [Chat: 1 [Ask about Tortle Combat.]]
Use the extremely dense honeycomb on your adult or elder common brown rabbit.
Bring Gustav the soft clay, 2 law runes and the plump rabbit.
Talk to Edvard to the south.
Talk to Johann to the southwest.
Talk to Hofuthand at the west side of Grand Exchange. [Chat: 1 [Tortle Combat.]]
You will then need to give each tortle its correct weapon.

sub.t: Gustav. [Chat: 1 Give Gustav a weapon › 5 Dwarven army axe]
Johann. [Chat: 1 Give Johann a weapon › 4 Old rake handle]
"Weird" Alfred. (northeast) [Chat: 1 Give "Weird" Alfred a weapon › 8 Rabid chinchompa]
Wolfgang. [Chat: 1 Give Wolfgang a weapon › 1 Mismatched set of cutlery]

steps.t: Talk to Wolfgang, wait for the cutscene, and then talk with him again
